Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant contralateral mediastinal shift (trachea and heart shifted to the right), which indicates a space-occupying lesion like a massive pleural effusion rather than volume loss (atelectasis). Pneumothorax would appear radiolucent (black), and pneumonia typically does not cause such a profound mediastinal shift.
